entries.heading: Appropriations to the Department of the Treasury in this
ancestors: DIVISION E—FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2016
entries.text:
Sec. 114.  Appropriations to the Department of the Treasury in this 
Act shall be available for uniforms or allowances therefor, as 
authorized by law (5 U.S.C. 5901), including maintenance, repairs, and 
cleaning; purchase of insurance for official motor vehicles operated in 
foreign countries; purchase of motor vehicles without regard to the 
general purchase price limitations for vehicles purchased and used 
overseas for the current fiscal year; entering into contracts with the 
Department of State for the furnishing of health and medical services to 
employees and their dependents serving in foreign countries; and 
services authorized by 5 U.S.C. 3109.

entries.heading: None of the funds in this Act shall be used to implement
ancestors: DIVISION H—DEPARTMENTS OF LABOR, HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, AND EDUCATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2016
entries.text:
Sec. 114.  None of the funds in this Act shall be used to implement 
20 CFR 655.70 and 20 CFR 655.71.
    This title may be cited as the ``Department of Labor Appropriations 
Act, 2016''.

entries.heading: Funds appropriated to the Department of Defense for
ancestors: DIVISION J—MILITARY CONSTRUCTION AND VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2016
entries.text:
Sec. 114.  Funds appropriated to the Department of Defense for 
construction in prior years shall be available for construction 
authorized for each such military department by the authorizations 
enacted into law during the current session of Congress.

entries.heading: None of the funds in this Act shall be available for
ancestors: DIVISION L—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2016
entries.text:
Sec. 114.  None of the funds in this Act shall be available for 
paying premium pay under subsection 5546(a) of title 5, United States 
Code, to any Federal Aviation Administration employee unless such 
employee actually performed work during the time corresponding to such 
premium pay.

entries.heading: EXTENSION OF MODIFICATION OF TAX TREATMENT OF CERTAIN PAYMENTS TO CONTROLLING EXEMPT ORGANIZATIONS
ancestors: DIVISION Q—PROTECTING AMERICANS FROM TAX HIKES ACT OF 2015
entries.text:
SEC. 114. EXTENSION OF MODIFICATION OF TAX TREATMENT OF CERTAIN 
                        PAYMENTS TO CONTROLLING EXEMPT 
                        ORGANIZATIONS.

    (a) In General.--Section 512(b)(13)(E) is 
amended by striking clause (iv).

    (b) Effective Date.--The amendment made 
by this section shall apply to payments received or accrued after 
December 31, 2014.
